title: Boolean
description: Traits shared by the Boolean widgets (BOOL-*).

value.description: State of the control or indicator. Set by the host, or by the user in control mode.

default_state.description: State a latch returns to once the host has read it (BOOL-008).

mechanical_action.description: How the control reacts to the pointer (BOOL-007). With a latch, the host reads the value and restores default_state; without a host that does it, a latched value stays set.

latch_timeout.description: Seconds after which an unread latch expires (host side); 0: never.

confirm.description: Ask for a confirmation before changing the value (BOOL-011).

_pressed.description: True while the pointer (or Space / Enter) is held on the control.

_seq.description: Sequence number of the last press / release update sent by the front end; a host drops an update whose number is not newer (BOOL-010).

x-awi-messages.description: An unread latch expired (latch_timeout): the view flashes.
